# Index reader: each fixture is a git CLI index that takes its own format path: a plain index with optional extensions and name keys, a merge conflict with only stages 1 to 3, version 4 prefix compression with index.skipHash, SHA-256 through the common dir's config, a split index with its shared index, a sparse index, linked worktrees, submodules and .git links as owners, an unreadable index in four ways, and an index replaced by a rename with the same size and time. No existing test reads a git index.
# Matcher: the RFC 0033 §4 order for a file a git index lists, below a folder a .gitignore excludes, against .koiignore, the local list and the built-ins. The existing rules tests set no listed files.
# Fs and driver: a watcher scans and rescans what the index lists as git adds, untracks and a work tree is renamed, and the engine includes what the scan reports. No existing scan or watcher test reads an index.
